citations.A1: `_cache` is filled on first call and never re-checked against the file, so nothing can ever invalidate it — fix by stat'ing the file each call and reloading when it changed
citations.A2: NOT a fix: a TTL/expiry — it still serves stale values for the whole window and re-reads when nothing changed.
citations.A3: NOT a fix: an explicit `clear_cache()` for callers to invoke — external edits (deploy, editor, another process) never call it
citations.A4: `path` is ignored by the cache — a second call with a different path returns the first file's data; key the cache by the resolved absolute path.
citations.A5: NOT a fix: a lock around the load — removes a race, not the staleness.
citations.A6: NOT a fix: returning `copy.deepcopy(_cache)` — stops caller mutation leaking, unrelated to disk changes.
